sourceText:
Red Bean Curry
By: miansari66
Published: Thursday, November 25, 2010 - 9:38pm

Ingredients




250 grams Red Bean (Soaked in water for 4 hours)
2 nos.s tomatoes chopped
2 nos.s Onion chopped
Ginger  crushed 2 inch  long piece
Garlic  crushed  1 medium pod
Oil  1 cup
Coriander fresh a few for garnish
Spices: Curry Powder 3-4 tablespoon

Preparation

1 Fry onion in oil till golden brown. 2 Now add tomatoes, garlic, ginger , curry powder , soaked red beans and fry for 2-3 minutes. 3 Now add 2 glass of water and cook on medium flame till beans are tender. 4 Sprinkle coriander leaves and simmer.
Red bean curry is ready 
Serve with Roti/ Naan/Boiled Rice

About


It is a very tasty and protein rich recipe.
